title: 2 field-cube components with two-sided bounded search

claims.statement: The explicit 2-component degree-500 field-cube encoder with its stated two-sided radius-56/54 decoder for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses has average block error at most 108399998260178733/500000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 two-sided decoder uses at most W=5582359573820155133859214214318712927602284408009947544434779070256176871963532 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(32699/125).

experiments.purpose: Check exact digit-coefficient imbalance envelopes, occupied-volume error, field irreducibility, fixed root circuit and both search counts.
